newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Interdiscount France sale deal - Spector.
newsitem.headline: Interdiscount France sale deal - Spector.

text.p: Belgian photo processing group Spector said on Friday it had reached an agreement in principle with the former owner of its French Racine unit to sell him its Interdiscount France unit.

It said in a statement that Serge Buga, who was named general managing director of Interdiscount France in December 1996 and recently resigned as Spector director, had agreed in principle to buy all shares in Interdiscount France and convertible bonds underwritten by Spector and its controlling shareholders, Fotoinvest and Swiss photo finishing group Porst Holding AG.
Spector said earlier this month it had included a provision of 223 million Belgian francs, linked to Interdiscount France, in 1996 earnings.
